subject: zombie
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: zombie, in the place of the game's models/zombie.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/hgrunt.mdl, models/barney.mdl, models/islave.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, A, B, A where the asset was B, D, D, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Outline matches the brief's words in all ten views: upright-to-hunched scientist, a bulbous cream parasite mass over the head, long arms reaching well past the hips with clawed hands, and a forward lean in the LEFT and RIGHT views. Nothing sticks out or is missing.

M2.reason: Measured size 38.5 x 53.8 x 68.4 against the 68 asked (sizeOff 0.006), so height is within 10% and the width and length are within the measure's tolerance.

M3.reason: Small parts checked against the brief: the parasite over the head (present, cream sack with a dark red collar), two long clawed hands with about four claws each (FRONT, FRONT-LEFT, BACK), two legs and two boots, the lab coat open at the front, and the torn, bloodied coat painted on the back and sides. The torn hem and rips are painted rather than modelled, which counts as there. No other part the brief names is missing.

M4.reason: Coat is off-white with red blood staining across the torso, arms and legs; the claws and boots are dark red-brown; the parasite is cream-yellow. These match the brief's lab coat, bloodied and torn, and the parasite's look. No region reads as the wrong colour or material.

M5.reason: Blood smears, rib-like banding on the chest and back, the coat's tears and the claw detail are all painted and sharp at the size the game shows (FRONT, BACK, ATTACK frames). Nothing is smeared beyond what the brief's bloodied look asks for.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up test, as the rubric sets. In lineup.png the asset (A) beside hgrunt, barney and islave: the line-up test was read four times in shuffled orders, and the judges never picked the asset as the one not made by Valve. It passed for one of the game's in all four readings.

M7.reason: Front is clearly the front: the coat opens on the chest and the claws reach forward in FRONT and FRONT-LEFT. The figure is upright or hunched on its own feet, and the soles sit on the floor line in every frame of motion.png and attack.png.

M8.reason: SMAK's check passes with no errors. Triangles 844 against a limit of 1008 (twice the Half-Life median of 504, which is more than three quarters' 731). In the views the torso's rib and cavity panel is painted and reads as closed; no open or inside-out faces show from any angle.

C1.reason: Walk frames 0 to 59 and attack frames 0 to 35 show the arms, claws and head staying on the body through the stride and the slash (for example attack 10 and 20, where the arms reach out but stay attached at the shoulders). The feet stay on the floor line in every frame, and nothing sinks or floats. The frames are small, so a close check of the claws at the far end of each stroke is advised, but nothing visible comes apart.
